critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Step 1 h3 renders '1Teach by walking' with no visible separator between the aria-hidden number badge and title; CSS likely handles spacing but worth confirming visually in production builds.

SpecialistRows renders row text as `Would have said: {text}` for held-back items; the acceptance spec examples use the reason-only format ('Held back: another cue 1.5 s earlier'). Current output includes both the full would-have-said text and the reason — richer than requested, acceptable but worth confirming with design.
HeroVisual: on failure path card is set to CARDS[1] (held-back) which matches spec, and the 3D variant doesn't fetch /api/demo/points if WebGL unavailable — good.
seed_data_creation: none; no POSTs were made (attempts count unchanged as required)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 16 landing page is fully compliant with the spec. Hero 3D loop takes ~18s per pass under headless software WebGL; use 65s timeout when checking card alternation. Reduced-motion & no-WebGL fallbacks both show the held-back card by default (CARDS[1]). Specialist rows depend on /api/demo/scene returning review_attempt_id; if backend changes, SpecialistRows will hide gracefully.
